steps.title: First PCR – DNA‑seq library
steps.instruction: Amplify barcode and insert from the plasmid pool.

substeps.instruction: Set up a 50 µL PCR on ice containing: 25 µL 2× KAPA mix (Roche), 0.8 µM DNA PCR1 forward primer (0.8 µL), 0.8 µM DNA PCR1 reverse primer (0.8 µL), 10 ng plasmid DNA, and nuclease‑free water to 50 µL.
Run the thermocycler (heated lid) with: 98 °C 45 s (1 cycle), 98 °C 10 s (10 cycles), 59 °C 20 s, 72 °C 30 s, 72 °C 2 min (final extension), hold at 4 °C forever.

steps.title: Purify PCR‑1 product (SPRIselect)
steps.instruction: Clean up the first PCR using SPRIselect magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex beads to resuspend.
Add 1.8 vol (90 µL) beads to the 50 µL PCR reaction.
Mix well, incubate 5 min at 20‑25 °C.
Place tube on magnetic rack, incubate 5 min, discard supernatant.
While still on the magnet, wash twice with 80 % freshly prepared ethanol, 30 s each wash.
Centrifuge briefly, keep on magnet, remove residual ethanol.
Air‑dry beads 2‑3 min.
Resuspend beads in 20 µL elution buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5), incubate 2 min at 20‑25 °C.
Place on magnetic rack 5 min, transfer eluate to a clean LoBind tube, avoiding beads.
Measure DNA concentration with Qubit HS DNA kit (expect 2‑8‑fold amplification).

steps.title: Second PCR – add Illumina adapters (DNA‑seq)
steps.instruction: Add Illumina adapters to the purified PCR‑1 product.

substeps.instruction: Set up a 50 µL PCR on ice containing: 25 µL 2× KAPA mix (Roche), 0.8 µM DNA PCR2 forward primer (0.8 µL), 0.8 µM DNA PCR2 reverse primer (0.8 µL), 15 µL PCR‑1 product, nuclease‑free water to 50 µL.
CRITICAL: Use a distinct Illumina barcode primer for each independent plasmid library.
Run the thermocycler (heated lid) with: 98 °C 45 s (1 cycle), 98 °C 10 s (5 cycles), 68 °C 20 s, 72 °C 30 s, 72 °C 2 min (final extension), hold at 4 °C forever.

steps.title: Purify PCR‑2 product (SPRIselect)
steps.instruction: Clean up the second PCR using SPRIselect beads (1 vol).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 vol (50 µL) SPRIselect beads to the 50 µL PCR‑2 reaction.
Follow the same bead‑binding, wash, and elution steps described in step 2.
Expect 5‑15‑fold amplification of the template DNA.

steps.title: Check DNA‑seq library size distribution
steps.instruction: Assess library fragment size using a Bioanalyzer or Fragment Analyzer (Agilent).

steps.title: Remove primer dimers and >1 kb fragments (DNA‑seq)
steps.instruction: Perform an additional SPRIselect cleanup according to the manufacturer’s instructions to eliminate unwanted fragments.

steps.title: Pool DNA‑seq libraries equimolarly
steps.instruction: Combine the purified DNA‑seq libraries in equimolar amounts as instructed by the sequencing facility.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA from total RNA
steps.instruction: Generate cDNA using reporter‑gene‑specific primers with UMIs.

substeps.instruction: Set up a 13 µL reverse‑transcription annealing mix on ice: 1 µL 2 µM gene‑specific primer with UMI, 1 µL 10 mM dNTP mix, 5 µg total RNA, nuclease‑free water to 13 µL.
Mix, centrifuge briefly, incubate 65 °C 5 min, place on ice ≥1 min.
Prepare 7 µL reverse‑transcription mix on ice: 4 µL 5× SSIV Buffer, 1 µL 100 mM DTT, 1 µL RNaseOUT, 1 µL SuperScript IV RT.
Add the 7 µL RT mix to the 13 µL annealed RNA (total 20 µL).
Incubate 1 h at 52 °C.
Heat‑inactivate 10 min at 80 °C.
Pause point: store cDNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: First PCR – amplify reporter‑gene cDNA (RNA‑seq)
steps.instruction: Amplify cDNA while avoiding plasmid‑DNA contamination.

substeps.instruction: Set up a 100 µL PCR on ice containing: 50 µL 2× KAPA mix (Roche), 0.8 µM RNA PCR 1 forward primer (0.8 µL), 0.8 µM RNA PCR 1 reverse primer (0.8 µL), 5 µL cDNA, nuclease‑free water to 100 µL.
Run the thermocycler (heated lid) with: 98 °C 45 s (1 cycle), 98 °C 10 s (15 cycles), 65 °C 20 s, 72 °C 45 s, 72 °C 2 min (final extension), hold at 4 °C forever.
Purify the PCR product with the MinElute PCR Purification Kit, eluting in 20 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.5).
Quantify DNA (Qubit HS); expect 40‑200 ng total yield.

steps.title: Second PCR – add Illumina adapters (RNA‑seq)
steps.instruction: Add Illumina adapters to the first‑PCR product using the same barcode primers as before.

substeps.instruction: Set up a 25 µL PCR on ice containing: 25 µL 2× KAPA mix (Roche), 4 µL 0.8 µM DNA/RNA PCR 2 forward primer, 4 µL 0.8 µM DNA/RNA PCR 2 reverse primer, 15 µL PCR‑1 product, 2 µL nuclease‑free water.
Run the thermocycler (heated lid) with: 98 °C 45 s (1 cycle), 98 °C 10 s (6 cycles), 68 °C 20 s, 72 °C 15 s, 72 °C 1 min (final extension), hold at 4 °C forever.

steps.title: Purify second PCR product (right‑sided size selection)
steps.instruction: Clean up the RNA‑seq library using a two‑step SPRIselect protocol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.6 vol (30 µL) SPRIselect beads to the 50 µL PCR reaction, mix, incubate 5 min at 20‑25 °C.
Place on magnetic rack 5 min, collect the supernatant into a clean LoBind tube.
Add 1.2 vol (60 µL) SPRIselect beads to the supernatant, mix.
Continue purification as described for the left‑sided protocol (wash twice with 80 % ethanol, air‑dry, elute in 20 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.5).
Measure DNA concentration (Qubit HS); expect 2‑6‑fold amplification of input DNA.

steps.title: Check RNA‑seq library size distribution
steps.instruction: Assess fragment size with a Bioanalyzer or Fragment Analyzer (Agilent).

steps.title: Remove primer dimers and >1 kb fragments (RNA‑seq)
steps.instruction: Perform an additional SPRIselect cleanup according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Pool RNA‑seq libraries equimolarly
steps.instruction: Combine the purified RNA‑seq libraries in equimolar amounts as directed by the sequencing facility.

steps.title: Data pre‑processing (DNA & RNA)
steps.instruction: Run the insulator‑seq preprocessing scripts from the GitHub repository.

substeps.instruction: Download the appropriate scripts and training data (GEO accession numbers) from the repository referenced in ref. 5.
Execute either “BAC_screen.sh” or “Synthetic_screen.sh” depending on the assay type.
Obtain a table with columns: Chromosome, Start, End, Barcode, mCherry, eGFP, Ratio.

steps.title: Bin genomic data into 50 bp windows
steps.instruction: Create 50 bp bins and map insulator scores to them.

substeps.instruction: Generate 50 bp bins using a chromosome list: `bedtools makewindows -g chrom_list.txt -w 100 > 50bp_bins.bed`.
Assign median insulator score to each bin: `bedtools map -a 50bp_bins.bed -b final_table.bed -c 7 -o median -null 0 > 50bp_median.bedgraph`.

steps.title: Visualize insulator‑seq results
steps.instruction: Load the binned data into a genome browser or use Gviz for plotting.
